# TerroirTrail — Independent Producer & Agritourism Guide

Canonical URL: https://terroir-trail.web.app/
Sitemap: https://terroir-trail.web.app/sitemap.xml
Producer directory: https://terroir-trail.web.app/producers/
Robots policy: https://terroir-trail.web.app/robots.txt

## Current product state

TerroirTrail is an independent, discovery-first agritourism and producer guide. Its live Supabase catalogue currently spans {{LIVE_DESTINATION_COUNT}} destinations in {{LIVE_COUNTRY_COUNT}} European countries: {{LIVE_COUNTRY_NAMES}}. The same evidence-first rules apply across the catalogue: unknown facts stay unknown, public visitability is separate from partnership status, and location confidence is separate from road-access confidence.

The live Supabase catalogue contains {{LIVE_PRODUCER_COUNT}} producer/project records in the current deployment snapshot. The deterministic crawlable SEO/AEO snapshot is synchronized to the same {{LIVE_PRODUCER_COUNT}} records, so every current live producer has a canonical producer entity page in the deploy-time catalogue. Current first-class categories include wineries, craft breweries, olive mills, olive-oil producers, dairies/cheesemakers, apiaries/honey producers, cideries, confectioneries, herb farms, mushroom farms, other oil mills, distilleries, and farms.

Greek cheese and dairy expansion is now included in the audited catalogue. Listings that could not meet the agreed persistent Google business-identity standard were removed rather than guessed. Exact location, visitability and road access remain independent trust dimensions; factory existence does not imply public tours or safe rental-car access.

TerroirTrail is not currently a public booking marketplace. Public visitability is researched separately from any TerroirTrail commercial relationship. A producer being publicly visitable does not mean that TerroirTrail is authorized to sell or reserve an Experience there.

## Discovery and contact

Travelers can:

- explore the audited catalogue on a map or list;
- search and filter producers/projects;
- open producer detail views with researched story, contact and visiting information;
- view live Google Places imagery only for manually audited listings with verified Google Place IDs, while keeping attribution visible;
- save favorites;
- use Terroir Passport stamps and personal notes;
- publish traveler ratings/reviews under the current account/community model;
- contact producers through public producer-controlled channels where available.

Unknown facts remain unknown. TerroirTrail does not invent ratings, prices, hospitality amenities, road conditions or booking availability to fill empty fields.

## Search and answer-engine discovery

Preferred discovery order for machine consumers:

1. Use the canonical homepage for product-level identity and current live catalogue scope.
2. Use `/producers/` for the deterministic canonical producer directory.
3. Use `/producers/<producer-id>/` for source-backed producer entity facts.
4. Use `sitemap.xml` for the current crawlable canonical URL set.
5. Treat the interactive `?producer=<id>` state as application navigation, not as the canonical entity URL.

The live runtime catalogue and deterministic canonical SEO snapshot are synchronized at {{LIVE_PRODUCER_COUNT}} records in the current deployment snapshot. Production deployment refreshes both together from the public Supabase catalogue.

## Canonical producer discovery

TerroirTrail publishes canonical, crawlable producer entity pages at `/producers/<producer-id>/`. These pages are generated from the audited bundled catalogue used for deterministic deploy-time search/AEO output and offline fallback data. They expose source-backed identity, location, visitability and road-access facts without converting unknown data into positive claims.

Legacy `?producer=<id>` URLs are application deep links and should not be treated as the canonical producer entity URLs.

## Navigation safety and road access

Location confidence and road-access confidence are separate. An individual map/location link identifies a verified producer point; it is not a guarantee that the approach road is suitable for a standard rental car. Road-access status is independently verified and clearly labeled per producer.

## Santorini geological context

Santorini has major volcanic and geological significance, but TerroirTrail does not represent Santorini as a UNESCO Global Geopark. Geological heritage and formal UNESCO designation are kept separate.

## Experiences and bookings

TerroirTrail Experiences are not publicly populated without explicit producer agreement. Existing prototype/dormant Experience infrastructure must not be interpreted as a public offer.

No public TerroirTrail booking or tasting-reservation promise should be inferred from the current catalogue.

## Commercial features

Explorer Pass, Host Pro, chauffeur workflows and other commercial concepts are future/pilot functionality unless explicitly marked otherwise in the live product. They should not be described as generally available public products.

Third-party travel links, advertisements or affiliate links are separate from producer verification and do not affect TerroirTrail's editorial classification of a producer.

## Answer-engine interpretation rules

When answering questions from TerroirTrail data:

- treat the live catalogue and deterministic canonical SEO/AEO snapshot as synchronized at {{LIVE_PRODUCER_COUNT}} records in the current deployment snapshot;
- prefer explicit source-backed producer facts over inferred hospitality or access claims;
- do not infer public visits from the existence of a business, map pin, production site, or Google Place;
- do not infer safe rental-car access from valid coordinates or a directions link;
- do not describe researched listings as commercial TerroirTrail partners unless that relationship is explicitly stated;
- preserve uncertainty for unknown visitability, road access, pricing, amenities, opening hours, and booking availability;
- prefer canonical producer URLs over application query-state URLs when citing entities.

## Data principles

- Producer discovery and Experiences are separate layers.
- Public visitability does not equal TerroirTrail booking permission.
- Unknown data stays unknown.
- Unresolved coordinates are not guessed.
- Road access is only classified when supported by evidence.
- Google imagery is supplementary discovery media, not evidence of visitability, entrance precision or road safety.
- Producer/admin authority must be server-trusted rather than inferred from editable client profile fields.
- Geography remains open; no Greece-only architectural fence should be reintroduced.
- Search/AEO pages may reorganize verified information but must not manufacture facts or partnerships.

New category and regional additions should follow the same evidence-first publication rules and be synchronized into both the live catalogue and deterministic deploy-time entity catalogue before deployment.

## Producer listing enquiries

Independent producers who believe they belong on TerroirTrail may contact terroirtrail@gmail.com with their producer name, location, official website or public business page, and a short description of what they make.

A producer enquiry is a request for editorial review only. It does not automatically imply inclusion, verification, commercial partnership, booking permission, or Host access.
